# Verification Skill

Use this skill to validate implementation evidence against requirements and risk checks.

Procedure:
1. Read the requirements and the implementation under test.
2. Run the relevant unit, integration, and edge-case checks.
3. Verify documentation and output quality expectations.
4. Record pass/fail evidence and identify any failures or gaps.
5. Stop for human approval before marking the work as accepted.

Never hide or silently fix failing verification results.
